name: grp-mcp-mac
description: Superseded by the grp-mcp plugin, which is cross-platform as of 0.81.0-rc15 and identical to this one; this stays published so existing macOS and Linux installs keep updating. It existed because grp-mcp used to bundle a Windows .exe that a Mac could not execute; both now run the same code through uvx, so the split has no purpose left. Install ONE of the two, never both - they register the same server name. Needs uv: 'brew install uv'. Run the grp-mcp-setup command in this plugin's README once to create your connections file; the server then finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc40): identical to grp-mcp. The tools now check that a record they opened by its key is the record that was asked for, before they write to it; on a screen set to the Classic UI the change could be saved to a different record (found on Row Sets, CS206010, on 2026R1). Row Sets on 2026R1 can now be edited through the tools. The server program is now downloaded from a GitHub release of this repository instead of PyPI. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
